context_visible: Aerial view of a rural settlement with multi-story residential buildings featuring red and grey roofs, adjacent to large agricultural fields with visible crop rows and harvested stubble.

Vegetation and small garden plots are visible between the buildings.
cross_view_relations: The zoomed crop focuses on a specific cluster of buildings visible in the upper-left quadrant of the wide context image.
